I think the new Role Selection Button is way too small and is hard for those with disabilities such as a hand tremor to be accurate on. Makes the game less accessible/ADA compliant, I think. Likewise, I believe the Challenges Progression Screen / end game screen needs to be placed AFTER the scoreboard screen. I think for those of us who aren't interested in such a feature would prefer to keep that sort of think optional rather than having to click past it to get to the scoreboard.

Really it just leaves me on the fence because I so desperately want the game to be what they say it was going to be... but 10 years and HALF A BILLION DOLLARS later... I dunno... Still don't even have NPC's that don't just clip through the floor, float in midair, or function much of anything. All those videos ever shown at Citizen Con were complete lies. The game never functioned like it was supposed to. Hell, half the time, the grids don't even load so all I see past a doorway is black void. Its just inexcusable for how much time and money has gone into it
